guard: a delivery daemon refuses reloadCreds, with nothing adopted, until it has finished starting, so a boot-time adoption landing after the ready flip cannot reconnect its connection under the start-up awaits still pending and make it exit (#2304)
why: The unfixed daemon died 1-2 times per 20 trials near offset 0 and never past ~40 ms, so the
death cell alone survives a reverted fix most runs. The reply cell is the deterministic one: an
adoption that lands before start-up finished must come back as the not-started refusal.
The daemon child runs bin/dist, which resolves workspace packages to their compiled dist, so
the suite script builds first and each mutant rebuilds after restore.

mutations.expectRed: an adoption landing before start-up finished was refused as not started, nothing adopted
